gem_guidance.text: In regards to gemming correctly, there are going to be some cases where we use appropriate color sockets, with the primary focus to fulfill the 2 Yellow and Blue requirements for our best Meta gem: Relentless Earthstorm Diamond . However, we will typically always gem pure Strength, unless the bonus for gemming awards additional Attack Power or Strength correctly. There is a little more nuance to Ret Paladin gemming versus some other classes.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Retribution Paladin DPS Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 4 Gear Guide - Wowhead
